thread.title: Nintendo Has A Much Better Lineup Than The Stock Suggests - Nintendo Co., Ltd. ADR (OTCMKTS:NTDOY)

author: Gregory Silverstein
title: Nintendo Has A Much Better Lineup Than The Stock Suggests - Nintendo Co., Ltd. ADR (OTCMKTS:NTDOY)
text:
Nintendo ( OTCPK:NTDOY ) has struck gold with their latest Pokémon games. Pokémon Let's go Pikachu and Eve . This game is the first main series RPG Pokémon game to the Switch, and it will undoubtedly drive console sales.
There has never been a Pokémon RPG on a gaming console. All Pokémon RPGs have always been on the Nintendo handheld devices. This could make a significant difference in the long-term success of the Switch. Nintendo has rebuilt its brand since the disastrous release of the Wii U, and Pokémon has been an instrumental tool in the rebuild. On May 29, 2018, Nintendo held a press conference revealing their plans for the Pokémon brand on the new Switch console.
The most exciting news to older Pokémon fans is the latest edition of the successful Pokémon Franchise with the 8th generation game in the fall of 2019. This news alone could be worth 10-15 million copies in game sales, and this game alone could drive console sales significantly for Christmas 2019.
The Pokémon Let's Go game will offer a strong value proposition to Switch buyers that didn't exist until these games were introduced. To many fans, the Pokémon games alone are worth buying the console to play.
Allie Cooper, a 24-year-old freelance artist in Tampa, Fla., said she would buy a Switch if it meant she could play Pokémon games akin to the classics she grew up on. The franchise is "really important to me," Ms. Cooper said. Without Pokémon, the Switch "just doesn't have enough [games] to really draw me in." (Source: Wall St. Journal )
This kind of dedication to Pokémon video games will drive console sales in 2018 and 2019. Switch owners who buy based on Pokémon will likely buy one or more of the other popular games. Popular Pokémon games like Sun and Moon sold 16.1 M copies, and Ultra Sun and Moon sold 7.51 M copies. It is surely not impossible to assume Pokémon 2019 sells 10-15 million copies and Pokémon Let's Go sell 5-7 million copies. Remember, in 2016, Nintendo sold 14.69 million copies of Sun and Moon in 44 days.

This table shows the historical sales data of each generation of the Pokémon franchise. Based on this data, it is clear that Pokémon Let's Go can sell 5-7 million copies. The second edition of these games is a good indicator of expected sales for Let's Go. Ultra Sun and Moon sold 7.51 million copies since November 2017. In the last 2 years, Sun and Moon the 7th edition sold 23.61 million copies in the generation. This is very similar to the sales data from the Black and White Generation. These two games are very similar; they are both reiterations of the original game with minor changes. The sales are very similar, and other than X/Y, which also sold similarly, these games are our best indication of what to expect. The first edition sells 15.5-16.5, while the second edition sells 7.51-8.52 million copies. It's very possible Let's Go will sell 7 million copies.
The game is nostalgic! Pokémon Go Effect Pokémon Go saw tremendous success during the summer of 2016 because the game taped into the nostalgia effect of Pokémon. The Let's Go game is a combo between Pokémon Go and the Original Red and Blue version games. This is the game that fans wanted in 2016 and has already ignited a rush back to Pokémon Go ahead of the launch of Let's Go.
As of 6/7/18, Pokémon Go is the 8th Top Grossing App on the Apple App Store up from 10th place at the end of May. It's the 7th Top Grossing App in the Google Play Store . These ranks have changed day to day. I have seen it at 6 and 14 on different days. This is surprising as many thought the Pokémon go craze ended in 2016. Given the high ranking in the Top Grossing category after the May 29 event, I think it's likely Let's Go will be a major success. The new game will give the hard-core fans something to enjoy while they finish the next generation game. If Apple ( AAPL ) and Google (NASDAQ: GOOG ) (NASDAQ: GOOGL ) are making money off Pokémon in-app purchases, Nintendo will do very well with Fortnite. It was reported that Fortnite was downloaded over 2 million times on the switch in less than 24 hours.
The Nintendo Switch Online Service In September 2018, the Nintendo Switch Online Service goes live. The service will offer Individual Membership for $19.99 for 12 months or $3.99 a month and a Family Membership for $34.99 for 12 months. The feature includes Online Play for compatible games, 20 NES games, save data cloud backup, Nintendo Switch Online app for smartphones, and additional special offers. Special offers might include old games for free like Xbox Live . Bloomberg estimated in 2010 Xbox live was worth 1 billion dollars. The price of the package comes to about $1.67 per month versus $5 for Xbox live, so the revenue from Switch online will be one-third of Xbox live per person. If Switch online were to get 5 million subscribers per year at an average selling price of $20-30 per year, that would generate $100 million to $150 million in the first 12 months assuming all 5 million people purchase 12 months. This product has a lot of potential; as the Switch develops, it could become very valuable. The total addressable market is around 18 million subscribers and growing as console sales rise above 18 million in the next quarter.
Nintendo Labo
The Nintendo Labo is an innovative gaming product. This product is a toy, a video game and a perfect intro to coding for kids. Labo uses cardboard and coding to create awesome toys that work with the Nintendo Switch. The Toy-Con Garage allows users to create their own programs to work with the Switch. The console and controllers help operate the Toy-Con products. The Toy-Con Garage could be the perfect game for introducing computer programming at an early age. Nintendo needs to advertise this aspect of the Switch and the Toy-Con product offering to fully capitalize on the Nintendo Labo. This could be a hit children's toy this holiday season.
Super Smash Bros Ultimate
Super Smash Bros game is another major Switch Catalyst. The game comes out in December and offers multiple controller options. The game has every character from the previous games, and given the sales history of the franchise, this game could sell 10 million copies. Between the Let's Go series and Super Smash Bros Ultimate, the Switch will do very well.
Buy the Sell-Off This recent decline in share price presents a buying opportunity. In a recent Interview with Bloomberg Executive Reggie Fils-Aime tried to give shareholders confidence after analysts and investors showed disappointment in the recently announced lineup. Here is a video of the Interview . The major Takeaway is Fils-Aime's quote at the end of the video interview.
"It's the pacing of news, the pacing of launches that will drive the business forward, we're driving engagement on the platform, and that's what's most important." (Source: Bloomberg )
There are clearly more games coming. Buying NTDOY right now is betting that these games announced will outperform expectations and thus lead to higher earnings. The stock has declined almost 25% since the March 2018 high of $57. This is partly due to the massive rise in share price since summer 2016. This rise will continue in the long term as more games are announced.
Pokémon, Super Smash Bros, Labo, Switch Online, Fortnite, and the unreleased games will silence the doubters and drive the share price past $55 and near $60 by the end of the year. Nintendo's value is built not only on their annual sales but their ability to monetize engagement. Pokémon Go and Let's Go could be the key to monetizing engagement. Starbucks ( SBUX ) and Sprint ( S ) still have Pokémon Go sponsored Poke stops.
Financials In the last two years, Nintendo grew total annual revenue to 1.05 trillion yen up from 489 billion yen the previous year. Cost of revenue was 652 billion yen versus 290 billion yen. Gross profit grew to 403 billion, Yen up from 198 billion yen. Net income is 139.59 billion yen. Total assets grew to 1.6 trillion yen, and total liabilities are 310 billion yen. The company grew strong revenue growth on strong console sales . Nintendo wants to sell 20 million switch units this year. Switch Online will immediately add value; the online service could be worth between 110 billion yen and 330 billion yen annually. Nintendo is well positioned for future growth. The stock remains undervalued at $43 per share.
Conclusion The new Pokémon games, the Switch Online Service, and the Nintendo Labo could become three new sources of revenue. Pokémon Let's Go could become a recurring game tied to each generation of the original RPGs. These products can also have a major effect on console sales. The Pokémon Games and Nintendo Labo will make the Switch the most popular product during the 2018 holiday season. Nintendo Labo has massive coding education potential that could lead to millions of console sales, and the company will launch their online service in September that could be worth hundreds of millions of dollars annually.
Nintendo has very exciting products coming out in the next 18 months. Pokémon, Labo, Switch Online, and Super Smash Ultimate will deliver a big win for shareholders in the long term. Pokémon Generation 8 will be the ultimate difference maker and drive sales in 2019. Do not underestimate this company.
